**Required materials:**

1. Oatley, Chapters 14 & 15 (combined session)
2. Ballard-Rosa, Cameron, Layna Mosley, and Rachel L. Wellhausen. 2021. "[Contingent Advantage? Sovereign Borrowing, Democratic Institutions and Global Capital Cycles](https://doi.org/10.1017/S0007123418000455)." *British Journal of Political Science* 51(1): 353–373.
3. {{< fa headphones >}} [*Planet Money* ep. 689: A Hedge Fund, A Country, and A Big Sailboat](https://www.npr.org/sections/money/2016/03/11/470137394/episode-689-a-hedge-fund-a-country-and-a-big-sailboat) — NPR

::: {.callout-tip}
## In class today
- Writing prompt
- **Student-led article presentation** (Ballard-Rosa, Mosley & Wellhausen 2021)
- Lecture and discussion
:::

This combined session pairs Oatley's two developing-country finance chapters. Chapter 14 covers capital flows to developing countries and the Latin American debt crisis; Chapter 15 covers the global capital-flow cycle and the financial crises of the 1990s. Read both before class.
